name: Shri Narain Dass Gupta
education: B.Com. (Hons.), Chartered Accountancy Educated at Shri Ram College of Commerce, University of Delhi, Delhi and The Institute of Chartered Accountants of India, Delhi
permanent_address: B-4, Block-B, Gulmohar Park, New Delhi 110049
books: Indian Accounting Standards IFRS, US GAAP Comparison, 2005
social_activities: As President, Institute of Chartered Accounts of India, was instrumental in introduction of various accounting standards which were finally notified by Ministry of Corporate Affairs; was the first Indian elected on the Board of International Federation of Accountants (IFAC) which act as a regulator for 164 regulatory accounting bodies of 116 countries; was Chairman, of the group constituted by RBI to identify gaps and implementation of accounting standards by Banks in India; formulated Accounting Manual for municipalities in India for accrual basis of accounting; actively participated in N.C.C., Indian Red Cross and Scouts during student life both at school and college level
hobbies: Morning walk, yoga, physiotherapy, swimming and watching and attending sports meets
countries_visited: Thailand, Singapore, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, Qatar, Hong Kong, Bahrain, U.A.E., Macau, U.K., South Africa, Japan, Republic of Korea, New Zealand, Australia, China, Canada, Tunisia, U.S.A., Israel, Austria, Czech Republic, Hungary, Italy, France, Monaco, Germany, Switzerland, Denmark, Belgium, Slovenia, Mauritius, Mongolia, Turkey and Malaysia
other_information: Trustee, (i) Bombay Port Trust, Ministry of Surface Transport, Government of India, 1992-1996 and (ii) National Pension Fund System, 2015-2017; Director, Delhi Stock Exchange (nominated by SEBI), 1996-1998; Vice-President, Institute of Chartered Accountants of India, 2000-2001; President, Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI), 2001-2002; Member, (i) International Federation of Accountants, 2001-2004, (ii) Committee of Central Board of Direct Taxes, Ministry of Finance to revise and rationalize tax return forms, (iii) Group for Economic Survey of India, Ministry of Planning and Programme Implementation, (iv) Indian Council of Arbitration (ICA) and (v) Advisory Council of Comptroller and Auditor General of India, 2001-2002; acting Chairman (SEBI), Board of Directors, 2002-2004; Chairman, Board of Governors, Motilal Nehru National Institute of Technology, 2005-2011; working for upliftment of economically weaker sections, promotion of Indian heritage and culture and religious rituals
